description: Read the MangroveAI agent evaluation decision log for a strategy belonging to the authenticated user and organization. No audit record means unknown activity, not proof it never evaluated. This does not read platform evaluation records.

include_details.description: Also return each evaluation's market_snapshot, sdk_response and order_intents.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

name: list_evaluations
